text:
I shot all 14 pages at 400, 1200, 1920 and 3440 px and wrote `report.md`. Every page fails at at least one width: 53 of 56 page × width rows fail. No page scrolls horizontally at any width.

Your page list plus the extra sub-pages gave 14 pages. They are the five levels, then `sessions-and-tasks`, `deputy`, `process-system`, `deputy/roles`, `deputy/review-page`, `session-record`, one transcript session (`session-00324b25`), one record session (`voice-20261020`) and one cloud-voice session.

I opened and read only about 12 of the 56 shots. The console-error and 404 counts are computed by script for every row. The layout failure reasons come from those shots. I applied them to pages built the same way without opening every shot, and the report says so.

Failures, worst first:
- **404s on every deep page:** 60–110 console errors and 200–350 failed requests per page. The missing files are the day and page streams, `page.js`, task logs and `requirements.md`. The year and month pages have 6–12 errors, only at 1920 and 3440. `mastermind-deputy` owns this.
- **Column layout:** the first column is clipped under the sidebar at 1200 and 1920, tab labels are cut ("Sessior"), and the first column is empty at 3440. `mastermind-page` owns this.
- **400 px header:** the tab bar runs to the screen edge and TESTS is unreachable. Chips and detail tables are cut at the right. Nobody owns this yet.
- **Sessions table at 1920:** names are cut off ("Session and task sy…") while the cost column has spare width. Nobody owns this yet.
- **Wrong or empty content:** the `session-e00f55c9` report tab shows only "Cost: not tracked" and a table of dashes. The 2026 and 2026/10 side columns list task folders (`08/12/apps`) instead of sessions. Nobody owns this yet.
- **Timeout:** `session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/` timed out at 1920 and 3440 on the first run. It loaded when I stopped waiting for the network to go idle, and those two rows come from that second run.

I filed five tasks on this folder: three new ones for the unowned causes, and two marked COVERED (deputy for the 404s, page for the column layout). I logged "show: report.md — 14 pages, 14 fail". I fixed nothing, and I did not commit these files.

Everything is in `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/sessions-shots/`; `shots/` holds the screenshots.

All five queue-top tasks are complete. I merged one small fix (merge `e6e1f26f6`) and found the other four needed no code change.

- **Remove the "All sessions" back link:** already done. The live session page has no such link at 400 or 1920 px, and `ai/sessions/doc/ui/detail-layout.md` records it as dropped.
- **Drop the repeated session-ID line:** already done. No such line appears above the title at 400 or 1920 px.
- **Page load error after refresh:** I could not reproduce it. A fresh load of a session page has no failed requests, HTTP errors or page errors; two Doc console warnings remain, and the ask named no specific error. I marked it done with medium confidence.
- **One name for the sessions tab:** the fix. Four "All sessions" labels now read "Sessions" (dashboard chip, Now link, docs back link, mobile back title), plus the trail comment.
- **Check session indexing:** `AISessionIndex.test.mjs` passes. It covers only the record-only path, so I marked it medium confidence; I did not run a full count of transcripts against index entries.

The review of the label change passed with three notes, all answered. The worktree-watch warnings about empty space on `/framework/ai/`, `/framework/ai/AISession/` and `/framework/ai/sessions/v/mobile/` at wide widths are not from this change. I only changed label strings.

The final log line is in the task's `session.jsonl`.

Idle and finished. All five queue-top tasks are complete and merged (`e6e1f26f6`), the worktree is returned, and the final "show: 5 done" line is in the task's `session.jsonl`. I'm not working on anything now.

I appended the landing line to the queue-top task record. I haven't sent the `card_reply` the nag asked for, so no card has the one-screen summary yet.

The diff only changed label strings, so I didn't touch any readme. The module readmes describe structure and tools, and none of them quotes the old "All sessions" wording.

The five tasks ended like this:
- **Three were already done** (back link, repeated ID line, indexing test passes).
- **One was not reproducible** (the page load error).
- **One was fixed:** "All sessions" is now "Sessions" in four labels, merged as `e6e1f26f6`.

show: 4 done, 1 skipped. Merge `2d5faa43d`; links: /framework/ai/sessions/ · /framework/ai/queue/

- **Make all sessions items visible and clickable**, **Make every item visible and clickable**, and **Give the sessions tab clear hierarchy** are done with one fix. At phone width the Table/Rail toggle sat on top of the Variants/Phone chips. It now sits on its own line, which is one rule in `sessions.css`.
- **How I checked:** 400 px shots before and after, and a 1920 shot showing all rows. In a headless browser, a click on the first row opened its session; I did not click every row. Confidence is medium. The first two are duplicate asks, and I completed both against the same proof. The hierarchy ask had no other fault: the list already reads in order at both widths.
- **Cost breakdown check:** done, medium confidence. The cost test passes (3 of 3, including a real-log replay) and the haiku price is now verified. The sonnet-5-5 and opus-5-5 prices are still assumptions; there are no billed totals to measure them against, so I left them. The last account reconcile is 15 days old and shows a $42 gap.
- **Proposal class:** skipped and noted on the task. It is a new class plus a node-led loop, estimated at $6 or more, over the $3 line, so it needs its own mastermind.

The fix is CSS only, so the review was size none, and the merge went through. Worktree-watch flagged empty space on `/framework/ai/sessions/` at 3440 px. My rule only applies below 40em, so that warning is not from this change.
